correctness.rationale: From f′=aX²+c, direct resultant algebra yields Δ. Riemann–Hurwitz gives genus three for tame degree-three cover with five simple branch points. In a holomorphic basis dX/Y²,X dX/Y²,dX/Y, Cartier is the √-semilinear matrix [[0,0,√c],[0,0,√a],[0,1,0]]. Δ≠0 forces Cartier rank 2, so a-number 1; its stable semilinear rank is 0 if a=0, 2 if a≠0, giving the p-rank dichotomy and generic height-two slope pair. At a=0 the additive separable polynomial X⁴+bX²+cX (c≠0) yields four translations and three genus-one quotients Y³=U²+(c/t)U+d; each is supersingular j=0, and their odd-ℓ cohomology sum gives a product isogeny and supersingular Newton polygon. For finite q, count a=0,c≠0 and a≠0 with one excluded d per a,b,c. Independent exact GF(2)/GF(4) coefficient and Cartier calculations agree, not a substitute for all extensions.
